hunks.baseline: The meat hit the grill. Thick, red, and marbled with white streaks like snowflakes—it was the finest Hanwoo beef.
hunks.sol: The meat hit the grill. Thick and red, with white veins of marbling running through it like snowflakes—it was the finest Hanwoo beef.

hunks.baseline: The shape, the sound, the smell. All of it was intoxicating. The only thing I didn’t like was the price…
hunks.sol: The sight, the sound, the smell. All of it was intoxicating. The only thing I didn’t like was the price…

hunks.baseline: “Will this be enough? Let’s order more after we eat. Some special cuts, too.”
hunks.sol: “Will this be enough? We can order more after we finish. Some special cuts, too.”

hunks.baseline: Food in Murim was spicy, salty, and bland. And even then, more days than not, I couldn’t eat properly. For thirty days, my stomach had been abused with beef jerky, bigu pills,[^1] and rice balls.
hunks.sol: Food in Murim was either too spicy, too salty, or completely bland. And more often than not, I hadn’t even gotten to eat properly. For thirty days, I’d abused my stomach with beef jerky, bigu pills,[^1] and rice balls.

hunks.baseline: Every chew felt like walking on clouds. This piece, that piece, that one too—every last one tasted like heaven.
hunks.sol: Every bite felt like walking on clouds. This piece, that piece, the one over there—every last one tasted like heaven.

hunks.baseline: “No. I should hold back on overeating.”
hunks.sol: “No. I should avoid overeating.”

hunks.baseline: “We’re at twenty-five servings…”
hunks.sol: “We’re on our twenty-fifth serving…”

hunks.baseline: “Twelve servings each isn’t all that much.”
hunks.sol: “Twelve servings each isn’t that much.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve only eaten three servings.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve only eaten three.”

hunks.baseline: And so that storm of a meal came to an end. At last, Team Leader Choi opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: And so the whirlwind of a meal came to an end. At last, Team Leader Choi spoke.

hunks.baseline: “I said I was the one who killed them. The Priest and the Great Warrior, both.”
hunks.sol: “I told them I killed both of them. The Priest and the Great Warrior.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t mention it. Let’s call it a fair deal. If anything, there’s something I should thank you for, too.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t mention it. Let’s call it a fair deal. If anything, I have something to thank you for as well.”

hunks.baseline: The fact that nobody had died in the process would be a huge help for Guild publicity, too.
hunks.sol: The fact that no one had died in the process would be a huge boost to the Guild’s publicity, too.

hunks.baseline: *What if I hadn’t found my strength through Synchronization?*
hunks.sol: *What if Synchronization hadn’t restored my strength?*

hunks.baseline: Who knew? Someone probably would have died. Maybe nobody would have made it out alive.
hunks.sol: Who knew? Someone probably would have died. Maybe none of us would have made it out alive.

hunks.baseline: “You were already thinking along those lines.”
hunks.sol: “You’d already thought of that.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s good for both of us.”
hunks.sol: “It works out well for both of us.”

hunks.baseline: “Good for both of us. Both of us…”
hunks.sol: “Both of us. Both…”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi muttered to himself, then asked out of nowhere,
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi muttered to himself, then abruptly asked,

hunks.baseline: “Pffft.”
hunks.sol: “Pffft!”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi lifted the tablecloth and blocked the water, then smoothly produced a business card with practiced elegance.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi lifted the tablecloth to block the spray of water, then smoothly produced a business card.

hunks.baseline: What the hell was this? For a second I was completely thrown.
hunks.sol: What the hell was this? For a moment, I was completely thrown.

hunks.baseline: “Y-you’re making me a recruitment offer? Right now?”
hunks.sol: “Y-you’re trying to recruit me? Right now?”

hunks.baseline: I took the card, and for some reason I felt deeply moved.
hunks.sol: I accepted the card and, for some reason, felt strangely moved.

hunks.baseline: An actual recruitment offer, treating me like talent. F-rank Hunter Jin Taekyung, you’d come a long way.
hunks.sol: An actual recruitment offer—and he was treating me like talent. F-rank Hunter Jin Taekyung, you’d come a long way.

hunks.baseline: “Our Guild is still new, and we don’t have many people, but we’re excellent where it counts. For example…”
hunks.sol: “Our Guild is still new, and we don’t have many members yet, but we’re excellent where it counts. For example…”

hunks.baseline: “And because of that, our employee benefits are excellent.”
hunks.sol: “Which means our employee benefits are excellent.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, benefits based on solid finances!”
hunks.sol: “Oh, benefits backed by solid finances!”

hunks.baseline: “There’s no need to worry about restructuring.”
hunks.sol: “And there’s no need to worry about restructuring.”

hunks.baseline: “Will you come?”
hunks.sol: “Will you join us?”

hunks.baseline: “I have some circumstances that make it difficult right now. I need time.”
hunks.sol: “I have circumstances that make it difficult right now. I need some time.”

hunks.baseline: If I followed my heart, I wanted to sign the contract right away—signature, stamp, thumbprint, even a kiss mark.
hunks.sol: If I followed my heart, I’d sign the contract right away. Signature, stamp, thumbprint, even a lip print.

hunks.baseline: *But what if the System vanished tomorrow?*
hunks.sol: *But what if the System disappears tomorrow?*

hunks.baseline: I’d be dead broke.
hunks.sol: I’d be completely screwed.

hunks.baseline: “Is it a money problem?”
hunks.sol: “Is it about money?”

hunks.baseline: There was always a money problem.
hunks.sol: Money was always a problem.

hunks.baseline: But this was more important than that. I couldn’t get dazzled by the wad of cash right in front of me and snatch at it.
hunks.sol: But this was more important. I couldn’t let the wad of cash in front of me blind me into making a snap decision.

hunks.baseline: “100 million won.”
hunks.sol: “One hundred million won.”

hunks.baseline: “100 million?”
hunks.sol: “One hundred million?”

hunks.baseline: “Just the signing bonus. The rest will match the minimum terms for a C-rank Hunter.”
hunks.sol: “That’s just the signing bonus. We’ll match the rest to the minimum terms for a C-rank Hunter.”

hunks.baseline: That was dangerous. This time it was really dangerous.
hunks.sol: That was dangerous. This time, it was seriously dangerous.

hunks.baseline: But I held out with superhuman patience. Hadn’t I already learned that life wasn’t that easy?
hunks.sol: But I resisted with superhuman patience. Hadn’t I learned long ago that life was never that easy?

hunks.baseline: It could be money I’d end up choking on.
hunks.sol: I might end up choking on that money later.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi looked at me quietly, then nodded.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi studied me for a moment, then nodded.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi—no, Choi Minwoo—looked in silence at the seat Jin Taekyung had left, then took out his phone.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi—no, Choi Minwoo—silently stared at the seat Jin Taekyung had vacated, then took out his phone.

hunks.baseline: “—You bastard, you’re a ghost. I was just about to call you.”
hunks.sol: “You bastard—are you psychic? I was just about to call you.”

hunks.baseline: “How did that thing I asked about turn out?”
hunks.sol: “What happened with that thing I asked about?”

hunks.baseline: “—I looked into it because you asked, but… is there something about this Jin Taekyung guy?”
hunks.sol: “I looked into it because you asked, but… is there something about this Jin Taekyung guy?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s why I called you. So? What did you find?”
hunks.sol: “That’s what I called you to find out. So? What did you learn?”

hunks.baseline: “—It’s a dime-a-dozen case. Seven years ago he Awakened at twenty and was assessed as F-rank. There’s a record he finished first at the Hunter training center…”
hunks.sol: “Dime-a-dozen case. He awakened at twenty, seven years ago, and was assessed as F-rank. There’s a record of him graduating at the top of his class from the Hunter training center…”

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung’s past seven years spilled from the other end of the phone. Then, at one point, Choi Minwoo’s eyebrows twitched.
hunks.sol: The story of Jin Taekyung’s past seven years came through the phone. Then, at one point, Choi Minwoo’s eyebrows twitched.

hunks.baseline: “—Yeah. You know about that incident, right?”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. You know about that incident, right?”

hunks.baseline: How could he not? It had happened only two years ago, so Choi Minwoo remembered it clearly.
hunks.sol: How could he not? It had happened only two years ago, and Choi Minwoo remembered it clearly.

hunks.baseline: “—He was the only survivor. I checked that part myself, and it surprised me, too.”
hunks.sol: “He was the only survivor. That part surprised me when I checked it, too.”

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo tipped his glass of water. Thinking he’d grabbed a lead on how an F-rank Hunter had killed a mid-grade Rare Monster alone made his throat burn.
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo raised his glass of water. His mouth had gone dry at the thought that he might have found a clue to how an F-rank Hunter had killed a mid-grade Rare Monster alone.

hunks.baseline: “—He took six months off. The Hunter Administration kept sending investigators, and I guess he spent the time trying to get himself back together. You know how serious the incident was.”
hunks.sol: “He took six months off. The Hunter Administration kept sending investigators, and I guess he spent the time trying to get himself back together. You know how serious the incident was.”

hunks.baseline: “—That’s it. He went back to his Guild, ran Gates his ass off for a year and a half, then got fired. That was exactly three days ago.”
hunks.sol: “That’s it. He went back to his Guild, ran Gates until his ass fell off for a year and a half, then got fired. That was exactly three days ago.”

hunks.baseline: “—It was technically restructuring, but a booger-sized little Guild, restructuring? Please. The incident probably had a lot to do with it. They kept glancing nervously at the Administration, then pushed him out. From their perspective, he’d have been awkward to keep around.”
hunks.sol: “Technically, restructuring, but come on. What kind of restructuring does a booger-sized Guild like that need? The incident probably had a lot to do with it. They kept looking over their shoulders at the Administration, then finally pushed him out. From their perspective, he must’ve been awkward to keep around.”

hunks.baseline: “—As far as I can tell. Want me to send you the file separately?”
hunks.sol: “As far as I can tell. Want me to send you the file separately?”

hunks.baseline: “—Hey, hey!”
hunks.sol: “Hey, hey!”

hunks.baseline: That was the absolute minimum. The image of Taekyung driving a C-rank Rare Monster into a corner alone, with overwhelming strength and skill, kept flickering before his eyes.
hunks.sol: That was the absolute minimum. The image of Taekyung overwhelming a C-rank Rare Monster alone with tremendous strength and skill lingered before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: There were only two possibilities. He had been hiding his strength, or he had recently reawakened.
hunks.sol: There were only two possibilities. Either he had been hiding his strength, or he had recently reawakened.

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo suspected the latter, but that was still far beyond common sense.
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo suspected the latter, but even that defied common sense.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t as if only one or two Hunters retired without ever ranking up even once.
hunks.sol: Countless Hunters retired without ever moving up a single rank.

hunks.baseline: Choi Minwoo shook his head. He felt as if a ghost had possessed him.
hunks.sol: Choi Minwoo shook his head. He felt as though he’d been bewitched.
“That’ll be 1,937,000 won.”

hunks.baseline: He really did feel as if a ghost had possessed him.
hunks.sol: Now he really felt as though he’d been bewitched.

hunks.baseline: “Shit. I’m fucked.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck. I’m screwed.”

hunks.baseline: I dropped heavily onto the ground. The recycling area was a mess. The thing that should have been there was nowhere to be seen.
hunks.sol: I sank to the ground in the filthy recycling area. The one thing that should have been there was nowhere to be seen.

hunks.baseline: I’d been anxious ever since leaving Team Leader Choi. But I hadn’t expected someone to take it in less than half a day. I shouted into the empty air.
hunks.sol: I’d been anxious ever since parting with Team Leader Choi. But I hadn’t expected someone to take it in less than half a day. I shouted into the empty air.

hunks.baseline: And I got an answer.
hunks.sol: And an answer came.

hunks.baseline: On the roof of the goshiwon building,[^4] Jinho hyung was smoking in the same spot where I’d seen him that morning. He exhaled a plume of smoke with a wistful look, then went on.
hunks.sol: Jinho hyung was smoking on the roof of the goshiwon building,[^4] in the same spot where I’d seen him that morning. He exhaled a plume of smoke with a wistful look, then continued.

hunks.baseline: “I spent ten years crying, regretting it, and making vows…”
hunks.sol: “I spent ten years crying, regretting, and vowing…”

hunks.baseline: “What, you come up empty today?”
hunks.sol: “What, did today’s job come up empty?”

hunks.baseline: My voice drained of strength as I went on.
hunks.sol: My voice went limp.

hunks.baseline: “Cough, cough-cough!”
hunks.sol: “Cough! Cough-cough!”

hunks.baseline: Maybe he’d inhaled the cigarette smoke wrong. Jinho hyung coughed like a maniac before he finally managed to speak.
hunks.sol: Maybe he’d inhaled the smoke wrong. Jinho hyung coughed like a maniac before finally managing to speak.

hunks.baseline: I hadn’t expected the situation to change this much in just a few hours.
hunks.sol: I hadn’t expected everything to change this much in just a few hours.

hunks.baseline: Where was I even supposed to start looking? I sighed heavily.
hunks.sol: Where was I even supposed to start looking? I let out a heavy sigh.

hunks.baseline: “If I saw it, then I saw it. If I didn’t, then I didn’t.”
hunks.sol: “If I saw them, I saw them. If I didn’t, I didn’t.”

hunks.baseline: Was that even an answer, or just crap?
hunks.sol: Was that supposed to be an answer, or was he just talking shit?

hunks.baseline: “Look, it’s not that I want a finder’s fee or anything…”
hunks.sol: “Look, it’s not like I’m asking for a finder’s fee or anything…”

hunks.baseline: It definitely sounded like he wanted a finder’s fee.
hunks.sol: He was definitely asking for a finder’s fee.

hunks.baseline: Anyway, that wasn’t the point. I shot to my feet and asked,
hunks.sol: Anyway, that wasn’t the point. I shot to my feet.

hunks.baseline: “If I have to pick, I saw them.”
hunks.sol: “If I had to choose, I’d say I saw them.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m not asking for a finder’s fee, but what’s the expected amount, roughly?”
hunks.sol: “I’m not asking for a finder’s fee, but roughly how much would it be?”
“…One hundred thousand won?”

hunks.baseline: “Right. It’s hot out, so good luck with that.”
hunks.sol: “Right. Well, it’s hot out. Good luck.”

hunks.baseline: “The finder’s fee is 180,000 won.”[^5]
hunks.sol: “The finder’s fee will be one hundred and eighty thousand won.”[^5]

hunks.baseline: *Have you ever seen a daylight robber like this?*
hunks.sol: *What a goddamn highway robber.*

hunks.baseline: I was so dumbfounded I couldn’t even breathe. He’d hit me in the back of the head like this?
hunks.sol: The sheer audacity left me speechless. How could he pull something like this on me?

hunks.baseline: “But there wasn’t anywhere suitable to put it. My room’s too small, you know.”
hunks.sol: “But I couldn’t find anywhere to put it. My room’s too small, you know.”

hunks.baseline: How was I supposed to hit this guy so cleanly that people would say I’d really done it right?
hunks.sol: How was I supposed to hit this guy so thoroughly that word of it spread?

hunks.baseline: I clenched my fists until they shook.
hunks.sol: My fists trembled.

hunks.baseline: Seeing the capsule taking up half the studio as if nothing had happened, all I could do was let out a hollow laugh.
hunks.sol: The capsule sat there taking up half the studio as if nothing had happened. All I could do was let out a hollow laugh.

hunks.baseline: Of all the people in the world, Jinho hyung had taken the capsule.
hunks.sol: Of all the people who could have taken it, it had been Jinho hyung.

hunks.baseline: I opened the capsule lid. Then I picked up the user manual, which had been tossed onto the worn seat, and flipped to the last page.
hunks.sol: I opened the capsule lid, picked up the user manual tossed onto the worn seat, and flipped to the last page.

hunks.baseline: *It has to be a simple coincidence.*
hunks.sol: *It has to be a coincidence.*

hunks.baseline: But I couldn’t shake the unease. I stared at the capsule, the source of all these events.
hunks.sol: But I couldn’t shake the unease. I glared at the capsule, the source of everything that had happened.

hunks.baseline: The reason I’d thrown the capsule into the recycling area that morning was so I could forget everything. My life was already dry enough; I wanted to write it off as one nightmare and keep living my life as I was.
hunks.sol: I’d thrown the capsule into the recycling area that morning because I wanted to forget. Life was already hard enough. I wanted to write the whole thing off as a nightmare and go back to living my life.

hunks.baseline: But the situation had changed now.
hunks.sol: But now the situation had changed.

hunks.baseline: Then something occurred to me. I placed my hand on the surface of the capsule and murmured,
hunks.sol: Then something occurred to me. I placed my hand on the capsule and murmured,

hunks.baseline: Just as I thought. The corners of my mouth had just begun to rise when—
hunks.sol: Just as I thought. The corners of my mouth had begun to rise when—

hunks.baseline: Flustered, I checked every object in the room at random. The television, a ballpoint pen, even the pillow. Every time, the System displayed accurate information.
hunks.sol: Flustered, I checked everything in the room I could get my hands on. The television, a ballpoint pen, even my pillow. Every time, the System displayed accurate information.

hunks.baseline: But there was one exception.
hunks.sol: There was only one exception.

hunks.baseline: The capsule couldn’t be read.
hunks.sol: It couldn’t read the capsule.

hunks.baseline: Just in case, I picked up the user manual. Same result.
hunks.sol: Just in case, I picked up the user manual. The result was the same.

hunks.baseline: I flopped onto the bed. I stared blankly at the old, yellow-stained ceiling and thought.
hunks.sol: I flopped onto the bed and stared blankly at the old, yellow-stained ceiling.

hunks.baseline: For now, these were things I couldn’t understand. But one thing was certain.
hunks.sol: For now, none of it made sense. But one thing was certain.

hunks.baseline: Power had soaked into every fiber of my body. Internal energy writhed in my dantian.
hunks.sol: Power permeated every fiber of my body. Internal energy stirred in my dantian.

hunks.baseline: Synchronization had given me strength. Strength far beyond that of an F-rank Hunter. Strength enough to defeat a C-rank Rare Monster alone.
hunks.sol: Synchronization had given me strength. Strength far beyond that of an F-rank Hunter. Enough strength to defeat a C-rank Rare Monster alone.

hunks.baseline: It was the first recruitment offer I’d ever received. But I refused. When someone recognized me, fear had come before joy.
hunks.sol: It was the first recruitment offer I’d ever received. But I had turned it down. The fact that someone had finally recognized me brought fear before joy.

hunks.baseline: I’d endured seven years under the name of F-rank Hunter. A caterpillar that had only ever crawled through the dirt had, one day, grown wings called the System.
hunks.sol: I’d endured seven years with the label of F-rank Hunter. A caterpillar that had spent its life crawling through the dirt had suddenly sprouted wings called the System.

hunks.baseline: Fear was a natural feeling.
hunks.sol: Fear was only natural.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the past seven years flashed through my mind. The name F-rank, stamped on me like a brand despite all the insane effort I’d put in. Even the memories from two years ago, when I’d trembled at other people’s contempt, at the guilt and the helplessness.
hunks.sol: At the same time, the past seven years flashed through my mind. The name F-rank, stamped on me like a brand despite all the insane effort I’d put in. The memories from two years ago, when I’d trembled beneath other people’s contempt, my own guilt, and utter helplessness.

hunks.baseline: I already knew the destination.
hunks.sol: I already knew my destination.

hunks.baseline: An F-rank Hunter. I’d start by breaking this loathsome shackle that had tormented me for so long.
hunks.sol: I’d start by breaking the loathsome shackle of F-rank Hunter that had tormented me for so long.

hunks.baseline: *Let’s give it a shot.*
hunks.sol: *Let’s do this.*
